USE CASES

What you can do

Draft longer messages and notes

Dictate a message or a first draft, then read it on screen and edit the parts that need attention.

Dictate while reviewing references

Pin a notes field to keep dictating into it while you review material in another app.

Run keyboard commands by voice

Use a configured voice command to trigger a key, such as Enter, while dictating.

PRODUCT DETAILS

Features

01

Dictate into the current app

Press fn to start recording. Recognized text goes into the selected field. If you select a different app’s text field, subsequent text goes there.

02

Pin a text field

Hold Control and press fn to pin the field selected at the start. Text continues to go there when you switch apps. Recording stops if the target connection is lost.

03

Control recording with the fn key

Tap fn to toggle continuous dictation, or hold it to record only while the key is pressed.

04

Configure voice commands

When recognized speech matches a configured command, Cursay triggers the associated key. For example, you can configure an Enter command to use during dictation.

05

Optional text cleanup

When enabled, text cleanup revises the entire field after recording ends, including text you typed manually. This option is off by default.

06

Check status in the menu bar

See the current state in the menu bar and a small recording indicator. Launching the app does not start recording automatically.

WORKFLOW

How to use it

The basic steps to get started.

  1. 01

    Set up for first use

    Grant microphone and Accessibility permissions, and check the speech recognition service connection.

  2. 02

    Choose a text field

    Use the current field, or press Control + fn to pin a specific field.

  3. 03

    Start and stop recording

    Tap fn for continuous dictation, or hold it while speaking. Tap fn again to stop a recording started with a tap.

  4. 04

    Review the result

    Check and edit the inserted text. If text cleanup is enabled, review its changes too.

Frequently asked questions

Does everything run on my Mac?+

No. Speech recognition currently connects to an external service. This is not an offline-only product.

Can I download it now?+

The app is in development. An installer and distribution process for general users are being prepared.
